business_type: cyclical grower (AI-capex leveraged optics, currently in hypergrowth phase)
moat_source: capacity position and design wins in laser chips/OCS/CPO during a supply-constrained cycle; evidence: sold out, under-shipping demand ~30%, 47.9% non-GAAP GM - but optics pricing power has historically evaporated when supply catches demand

returns.assumption_note: Convergence to scenario IV by year 5, ~60% of the gap closed by year 3.

sensitivity_key_driver: revenue growth durability past FY2027 (cycle length)
primary_model_risk: Cycle duration: the entire gap between bear ($90) and bull ($746) is how long hyperscaler optics demand outruns supply. Optics cycles have historically ended abruptly; the model's base case assumes deceleration without collapse, which is itself an optimistic reading of the industry's history.
expectations_gap_key_variable: cycle persistence: at $728.32 (~61x annualized forward EPS) the price assumes hypergrowth well past FY2028; base case has growth decaying to ~12% by FY2030 and still lands ~40% below the current price
top_5_bull_arguments: +90% y/y revenue with +2,140bps operating-margin expansion is the best operating quarter in the space
Sold out and under-shipping demand ~30% after 40% capacity growth - revenue is supply-limited, not demand-limited
OCS backlog >$400M plus a multi-hundred-million CPO order gives visibility into CY2027
Q4 guide implies ~22% sequential growth with margins still expanding (OM 35-36%)
If hypergrowth persists (bull case), IV ~$746 - the bull case roughly equals today's price, meaning upside requires exceeding it
top_5_bear_arguments: Expected IV ($427.5) is ~41% below price; unusually, even the BULL case only matches the current quote - asymmetry is fully negative
Balance sheet grade C: meaningful debt, tight current ratios, preferred-stock raise - leverage into a cyclical peak
Optics history: every supply-constrained boom (2000, 2017 3D sensing, 2021 datacom) ended with double-digit revenue declines
Hyperscaler concentration means two customers' capex decisions can end the cycle
The -7.05% week alongside COHR/AAOI suggests the crowded AI-optics trade is already leaking
thesis_breakers: Any quarterly guide implying sequential revenue decline
OCS backlog flat or down sequentially
A hyperscaler capex cut cycle announced (industry-level breaker)
Liquidity stress: another emergency-flavored financing (preferred/converts) at worse terms
position_size_recommendation: 0% at current price; the business deserves respect but entry only makes sense near expected IV (~$427) or after the cycle's first guide-down resets expectations
notes_on_nulls: ROIC/ROE/ROA null: not captured as sourced figures (market snapshot + earnings-release research only). Revenue/EPS/margin inputs are reported; FCF path is constructed from guided operating margins less assumed capex intensity - confidence_level medium. Net debt not netted in scenario IVs (debt 'meaningful' per coverage but no sourced figure); this biases stated IVs slightly high.
historical_context: Directional context only - low confidence. Verified datapoints: +121% stock move over 12 months, -7.05% past week, analyst price target raised to $1,200 by one shop (pass1 web quotes). No verified 5-year multiple range captured; terminal multiples justified against cyclical-optics history, not company-specific trading ranges.
